mapper.sql: id, goods_id, total, available, locked, version, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock (goods_id, total, available, locked, version) VALUES (#{goodsId}, #{total}, #{total}, 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE stock SET available = available - #{num}, locked = locked + #{num}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} AND available >= #{num}
UPDATE stock SET available = available + #{num}, locked = locked - #{num}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} AND locked >= #{num}
